snippet.title: Perchang World - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Perchang World!

Get the balls to the goals using red and blue gizmos. Sounds simple, right? Well, good luck, because you're about to go on an adventure like no other.

Join the narrator (voiced by the amazing comedic talent of James Acaster), as you travel to foreign lands, into other dimensions and even through time!

Do you have the skills to save Perchang World?

Wishlist it here: 
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/perchang-world/id6477922353

Join our Discord to chat with the devs:
https://discord.gg/m4hzf8dbF4

Thanks for watching!

  -  The Perchang Team
